info.title: sprout-devtools
info.description: Unified Sprout developer CLI for build, launch, package, capture, UI Automation, isolation, and secure runtime inspection.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Build, run, test, and inspect Sprout applications.

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Run the generic target host over a Hyper-V socket inside a guest.

commands.name: assets
commands.description: Generate the MSIX visual-asset set and an app.ico from one input image.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Publish a Sprout project from source into a self-contained deployment directory.

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Cancel a queued or running localhost target-host job.

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Launch a Sprout app, wait for its window, and save a post-compositor PNG screenshot.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Build a Sprout app in Debug, launch it, and capture inspection evidence (window + UI Automation tree).

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Make a Sprout app resident: lay an unpackaged self-contained app down, and/or register a packaged (MSIX) loose layout.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Report the host environment (OS, build, DPI awareness, isolation, Developer Mode) and how to launch exe vs packaged forms.

commands.name: drive
commands.description: Launch a Sprout app and drive a control via UI Automation: find, act, and assert its state.

commands.name: drive-shell
commands.description: Drive a Sprout app live + multi-step over an in-guest channel in a clean Hyper-V guest.

commands.name: ensure
commands.description: Idempotently create a managed Windows Hyper-V pool.

commands.name: gate
commands.description: Launch a Sprout app and gate a real post-compositor touch-scroll gesture via Windows Graphics Capture.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate project assets from source material (no external tooling).

commands.name: host
commands.description: Run and consume the local multi-worktree target host.

commands.name: image
commands.description: Manage content-addressed Windows installation media.

commands.name: import
commands.description: Hash, verify, and cache a user-downloaded official Windows ISO.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Discover and inspect explicitly opted-in local Sprout applications.

commands.name: isolate
commands.description: Run the app's checks inside a clean isolated guest (Windows Sandbox) and collect the verdict.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List discoverable local Sprout diagnostics targets as JSON.

commands.name: mailbox-agent
commands.description: Run the generic target host over a mapped folder inside a Sandbox guest.

commands.name: pool
commands.description: Provision and inspect DevTools-owned Hyper-V pools.

commands.name: produce
commands.description: Pack a published Sprout app directory into a signed MSIX (self-owned, no external CLI).

commands.name: provision-worker
commands.description: Elevated internal worker for a prepared Hyper-V provisioning plan.

commands.name: record
commands.description: Record a bounded post-compositor H.264/MP4 video from a real app window.

commands.name: record-worker
commands.description: Internal bounded window-recording worker.

commands.name: repair
commands.description: Resume a managed pool from its durable manifest and owned resources.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run the full loop on a Sprout app: --selftest + window capture (exe), and/or packaged launch (msix), with parity.

commands.name: selftest
commands.description: Queue an app self-test on the localhost target and wait for its result.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the localhost target host until an idle stop, an explicit forced stop, or Ctrl+C while idle.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Print one managed Hyper-V pool manifest.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop an idle localhost target host.

commands.name: vm
commands.description: Import Windows media and manage DevTools-owned Hyper-V pools.
